### Reverent Worship
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/reverent-worship
Passage: Leviticus 10:1-3
Points:
- Nadab and Abihu suffered immediate death for offering unauthorized fire that God had not commanded.
- True reverence means adhering faithfully to God's revealed instructions rather than worshiping on human terms.
- God demands to be regarded as holy and glorified by all who lead and draw near in His service.
- Believers must recover a holy awe that honors God's character and lordship in Christian worship.

### Devotional: Leviticus 10
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-10-psalms-11-12-proverbs-25-1-thess-4/
Passage: Leviticus 10:1-7
Points:
- God requires exact obedience in worship because His supreme authority and holiness are at stake.
- Nadab and Abihu's unauthorized innovation reflected willful defiance rather than innocent error.
- Proximity to God's manifest presence brings greater responsibility and swifter divine judgment for disobedience.
- Aaron and his surviving sons were barred from public mourning to maintain their consecrated priestly calling.
- The severe judgment taught the priests to clearly distinguish between the holy and the common.
